texts.content:
The Numathiz is a highly lethal and intelligent predator. Its cruelty is so notorious
that even lifeforms outside its target prey fear it-eliminated simply for standing in its path.

Its morphology blends humanoid traits with insectoid features. It glows with
fluctuating intensity and releases neuro-sedative spores that impair
 the motor responses of its victims.

It feeds primarily on spinal marrow and cerebral tissue, which it extracts with surgical
brutality from the megafauna it hunts. The rest of the body is left intact, often
consumed by scavenger organisms, yet unmistakably marked by its evolutionary
arsenal: clean incisions, complete drainage, and a biological signature that cannot be mistaken.
